title: Welcome to Groovy Weirdo!
text:
This is my website for sharing my weird art and selling trinkets to fund more weird art.
Check out my portfolio or visit the shop to get in on the first batch of stickers.



pile of stickers

title: About
text:
Kristen Holsworth is a Michigan based artist that uses digital fabrication to create emotional objects. Through 3D printing and laser cutting she is able to make pieces that help her process memories and feeling, making objects that feel like part artifact, part daydream. 



Kristen on the campus print farm


Raised in the glow of early 2000s cartoons, clunky computers, sticker bombed CD players, and the hand me down influence of the 90s she works to preserve the nostalgia of growing up in a plastic, playful, awkward, and oddly tender world.
Contact
For sales information, commissions, or other questions, you can send me an email or send mail to the address below.

Groovy Weirdo 108 S Adams St # 980058 Ypsilanti, MI 48198
